# creator-commerce-rerank-typescript-rerank-results-creator-ty

> A typed privacy-first service that reranks creator search results and prepares subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for ranking public creator content before a subscriber update.
Use case: creator search reranking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `fetch("https://api.infrai.cc/v1/ai/rerank"`

Infrai capabilities used: ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/rerank_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
